measures.id: County of Muskegon Parks and Recreation Millage Proposal
measures.title: Parks and Recreation Millage Proposal
measures.summary: Would authorize Muskegon County to levy a new property tax of up to 0.50 mill ($0.50 per $1,000 of taxable value) for 2026 through 2035 to acquire, develop, improve, operate, maintain and preserve parks, recreational facilities, trails, greenways, natural areas and public access sites. Up to 30% of the money may be distributed to local governments in the county for the same purposes. The first-year levy is estimated to raise about $3,625,000, of which about $132,000 may be captured by local development and brownfield authorities.
measures.yesMeans: Muskegon County could levy a new tax of up to 0.50 mill for parks and recreation for 2026 through 2035.
measures.noMeans: The new parks and recreation millage would not be levied.
